read.thesis: Honda's nine-month operating profit fell 48.1% to JPY 591.5bn on EV write-downs and tariffs, and it cut its 2030 EV share target from 30% to 20%, a capital-cycle retreat from EV capacity.

capex.peers_comment: Competitors' EV expansion noted only as intensifying local OEM competition in Asia; no capacity commentary.
capex.quote: Honda decided to cancel development of certain EV models, and discontinue and reduce manufacturing of EV models jointly developed under a certain alliance agreement.

triggers.label: 2030 EV share target cut 30% → 20%
triggers.quote: the Honda global EV sales ratio in 2030 is now expected to be 20%, lower than the previously announced target of 30%.

triggers.label: EV model development cancelled
triggers.quote: Honda decided to cancel development of certain EV models, and discontinue and reduce manufacturing of EV models jointly developed under a certain alliance agreement.

triggers.label: EV incentives higher per unit
